title: Architectural Decision Lab (Links vs. Monitors) & Building my_gen_server:call/3
solutionExplanation: Implements the architectural decision matrix and reconstructs the OTP gen:do_call/4 synchronous protocol pairing calls with monitors.

otpDocCards.description: Creates temporary monitor providing 0ms notification if ServerPid crashes.

mentalModelCheck.question: Why should a client process use a monitor rather than a link when querying a shared server actor?

options.label: A monitor is unidirectional, allowing the client to detect a server crash in 0ms without sharing the server’s fate or dying itself.
options.explanation: Correct! If the client linked to the server, a crash in the server would terminate the client too. Monitors provide safe observation without fate-sharing.

options.label: Links cannot transmit messages longer than 64 bytes.
options.explanation: Links are signals, not message transports; message size is irrelevant.

options.label: Monitors allow the client to alter the server’s internal state directly.
options.explanation: Monitors never grant access to another process’s state.
